name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project, from planning to completion?
description: A tiny home project typically takes 7-13 months, including 1-3 months for planning/design, 1-4 months for permitting, and 3-6 months for construction.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a tiny home project, from planning to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a tiny home project can vary significantly based on customization, permitting, and construction complexity. Generally, planning and design phases can take 1-3 months. Permitting can add another 1-4 months, depending on local regulations and efficiency of the review process. Construction itself typically ranges from 3-6 months for a standard build. Highly customized or off-grid projects might require more time. Zen Tiny Homes works to streamline each stage for an efficient build.
